title.narrative: ODIHR Engagement in and Support for Ukraine

description.narrative: Project funding to the Office for Democratic Institutions and Human Rights (ODIHR) for their project “Programme on ODIHR Support for and Engagement in Ukraine”, which falls under the Programme of ODIHR Engagement in and Support for Ukraine. The project arises out of an earlier ODIHR project Advancing the Human Dimension of Security in Ukraine”, and aims at advancing the human dimension of security in Ukraine through the promotion of co-operation on human rights issues, using civil society networks and effectively strengthening the existing and building new partnerships with government stakeholders. This will include engagement in human rights monitoring and advocacy, gender equality, human rights compliant policing, freedom of assembly, political rights of persons with disabilities, anti-torture initiatives, and rights of victims of trafficking in human beings.
